date.source: The broadcast's own subject line reads 1/07/00; it was posted to the newsgroup on 7 January 2001, its own copyright line reads 2001 and its opening promo greets the New Year, so the year is read as 2001.

appearances.note: Arrived during the main event and distracted Doug Fury into the deciding pin.
Opened the broadcast and announced a Royal Rumble for the Heavyweight Championship the following week.

matches.note: DiArgo pinned Perez with the D-Drop; the broadcast calls it the first match the federation ever won.
Destructo came out unannounced as the replacement for a scheduled opponent who never arrived; Williams pinned him with the Long Neck Bottle, a neckbreaker from the top rope.
Main event. Fury had the Renaissance Man down after the Death Penalty suplex, but the arrival of "Outlaw" Joe Wayans distracted him and the Renaissance Man pinned him with the Shattered Dream.
